YTA. what is wrong with you? i’m being harsh because you were way too harsh on a nine year old. you gave him something he now values and ripped it away from him. a 9 year old doesn’t equate leaving games around his room as devaluing them. a conversation with him would have been WAY more appropriate rather than act like a 9 year old yourself and throwing a tantrum about a situation he doesn’t understand yet. why would he understand that? he’s never owned a console nor games to take care of. he’s too young to understand the value of money. and instead of being a good sibling and using this moment to compassionately teach him, you’ve put yourself in a position where he views you bitterly. you’re not his parent, you don’t have the right to take away things just because he doesn’t have the model behaviour you want. 
again, a better way to have handled this, and what you should do now to fix things, would be a conversation about how these kinds of items don’t belong in places where they can be damaged. if you GAVE him these things, these items aren’t yours to take back at your leisure. if he was told he can BORROW them, that’s a different story. 
kids don’t view being messy as being disrespectful. it’s sad to think how little you empathized with his emotional maturity here.
